candidates.title: Caste discrimination during SC man’s burial: Protest in Erode seeks action against officials
candidates.excerpt: The protesters demanded that officials be held accountable under the SC/ST Prevention of Atrocities Act for their alleged failure to prevent the humiliation meted out to members of an SC community

candidates.title: U.S. President wants 60 days to analyse impact of Russia sanctions law, says Marco Rubio
candidates.excerpt: On October 16, Mr. Trump waived key provisions of the Graham Act that authorised punitive tariffs on countries purchasing Russian oil, offering relief to India

candidates.title: China considers new export curbs on solar, AI, biotech
candidates.excerpt: The draft plan, “Announcement No. 48”, proposes a complete export ban on 14 technologies and restrictions on 26 more, including next-generation solar technologies that could affect countries such as India seeking to reduce dependence on China

candidates.title: Sri Lanka’s Tamil parties seek sustained Indian push to realise spirit of Indo-Lanka Accord
candidates.excerpt: Vice-President ‘assures’ them that India’s position on devolution stands; provincial polls discussed with Sri Lankan side
